entry.title: A place for art to begin and rest
entry.summary: Keep a simple drawing invitation ready, and give wet work or saved work somewhere to go. The space can support making without keeping every piece forever.
entry.cue: Materials are hard to find, or finished drawings keep gathering on the table.
detail: Davies describes toddler art trays with what is needed already together. Independent collecting of a whole set of materials is a later example, around 3 years.

Her options for finished work include a tray for things to return to, a selection in a scrapbook, a photograph of bulky work, or a changing display. Reusing a drawing as wrapping paper is another possibility.
Choose the arrangement that helps your family make and put things away; a separate art room is not part of the invitation.
